rows.question: Identify a list of genes expressed in lung cancer
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
gene_symbol_ensembl_crossref AS (
  SELECT
    ensembl_gene_id,
    gene_symbol
  FROM xref_gene_ensembl
),
-- differential expression for lung cancer (DOID 1324)
differential_expression_lung AS (
  SELECT
    de.gene_symbol,
    de.doid,
    de.log2fc,
    de.pvalue,
    de.adjpvalue,
    de.statistical_significance,
    de.expression_change_direction,
    de.subjects_up,
    de.subjects_down,
    de.subjects_nochange,
    de.subjects_nocoverage,
    de.subjects_total
  FROM differential_expression de
  WHERE de.doid = 1324
    AND de.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL
),
-- healthy expression in lung (UBERON:0002048)
healthy_expression_lung AS (
  SELECT
    he.ensembl_gene_id,
    x.gene_symbol,
    he.uberon_anatomical_id,
    he.uberon_developmental_id,
    he.expression_level_gene_relative,
    he.expression_level_anatomical_relative,
    he.call_quality,
    he.expression_rank_score,
    he.expression_score
  FROM healthy_expression he
  LEFT JOIN gene_symbol_ensembl_crossref x
    ON he.ensembl_gene_id = x.ensembl_gene_id
  WHERE he.uberon_anatomical_id = 'UBERON:0002048'
)
-- Combine results: prefer HGNC/gene_symbol when available, otherwise use ensembl id
SELECT
  de.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  'differential_expression' AS source_table,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'doid', de.doid,
    'log2fc', de.log2fc,
    'pvalue', de.pvalue,
    'adjpvalue', de.adjpvalue,
    'statistical_significance', de.statistical_significance,
    'expression_change_direction', de.expression_change_direction,
    'subjects_up', de.subjects_up,
    'subjects_down', de.subjects_down,
    'subjects_nochange', de.subjects_nochange,
    'subjects_nocoverage', de.subjects_nocoverage,
    'subjects_total', de.subjects_total
  ) AS evidence_detail
FROM differential_expression_lung de

UNION ALL

SELECT
  COALESCE(hel.gene_symbol, hel.ensembl_gene_id) AS gene_symbol,
  'healthy_expression' AS source_table,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'uberon_anatomical_id', hel.uberon_anatomical_id,
    'uberon_developmental_id', hel.uberon_developmental_id,
    'expression_level_gene_relative', hel.expression_level_gene_relative,
    'expression_level_anatomical_relative', hel.expression_level_anatomical_relative,
    'expression_score', hel.expression_score,
    'expression_rank_score', hel.expression_rank_score,
    'call_quality', hel.call_quality,
    'ensembl_gene_id', hel.ensembl_gene_id
  ) AS evidence_detail
FROM healthy_expression_lung hel
WHERE COALESCE(hel.gene_symbol, hel.ensembl_gene_id) IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY gene_symbol, source_table

rows.question: Show biomarker gene symbol and description for 'breast cancer'
rows.pred_sql:
WITH biomarker_core_49 AS (
  SELECT
    b.id AS biomarker_id,
    NULLIF(btrim(b.gene_symbol), '') AS gene_symbol,
    NULLIF(btrim(b.biomarker_description), '') AS biomarker_description
  FROM biomarker b
)
SELECT DISTINCT b.gene_symbol,
       b.biomarker_description
FROM biomarker_core_49 b
-- link biomarker -> biomarker_edrn by biomarker id matching biomarker_edrn.id
JOIN biomarker_edrn be ON be.id = b.biomarker_id
-- biomarker_edrn.uberon_anatomical_id -> cancer_tissue.uberon_anatomical_id -> cancer_tissue.doid
JOIN cancer_tissue ct ON be.uberon_anatomical_id = ct.uberon_anatomical_id
-- disease.id matches cancer_tissue.doid
JOIN disease d ON ct.doid = d.id
WHERE d.name = 'breast cancer'
  AND b.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY b.gene_symbol

rows.question: What is the test trade name for FDA tests which are actually used for predisposition?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH fda_test_use_with_identity AS (
  SELECT
    bfu.id AS id,
    bfu.test_trade_name AS test_trade_name,
    bfu.test_submission AS test_submission,
    bfu.actual_use AS actual_use,
    bfu.approved_indication AS approved_indication,
    t.test_manufacturer AS test_manufacturer,
    t.platform_method AS platform_method,
    t.test_approval_status AS test_approval_status
  FROM biomarker_fda_test_use bfu
  LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda_test t
    ON bfu.test_trade_name = t.test_trade_name
    AND bfu.test_submission = t.test_submission
)
SELECT DISTINCT test_trade_name
FROM fda_test_use_with_identity
WHERE test_trade_name IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    actual_use ILIKE '%predispos%'
    OR actual_use ILIKE '%predisposition%'
    OR actual_use ILIKE '%predispositional%'
  )
ORDER BY test_trade_name

rows.question: Get the biomarker gene symbol and biomarker description for disease with name 'breast cancer'
rows.pred_sql:
WITH gene_ensembl_to_uniprot_map AS (
  SELECT
    x.gene_symbol,
    x.ensembl_gene_id,
    x.speciesid,
    mpd.uniprotkb_ac,
    muc.uniprotkb_canonical_ac
  FROM xref_gene_ensembl x
  LEFT JOIN map_protein_disease_mutation mpd
    ON mpd.ensembl_transcript_id = x.ensembl_gene_id
  LEFT JOIN map_uniprot_canonical_id muc
    ON muc.uniprotkb_ac = mpd.uniprotkb_ac
),
biomarker_fda_tests_w_drugs_ncit AS (
  SELECT
    bf.id,
    bf.test_trade_name,
    bf.test_submission,
    bft.test_manufacturer,
    bft.biomarker_origin,
    bft.doid,
    bft.histological_type,
    bft.specimen_type,
    bft.platform_method,
    bft.test_number_genes,
    bft.test_adoption_evidence,
    bft.test_approval_status,
    bft.test_study_design,
    bft.clinical_significance,
    bfdd.biomarker_drug,
    bfn.ncit_biomarker
  FROM biomarker_fda bf
  LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda_test bft
    ON bft.test_trade_name = bf.test_trade_name
    AND bft.test_submission = bf.test_submission
  LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda_drug bfdd
    ON bfdd.biomarker_fda_id = bf.id
  LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda_ncit_term bfn
    ON bfn.biomarker_fda_id = bf.id
),
biomarker_core_88 AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(b.id, '') AS biomarker_id,
    NULLIF(b.gene_symbol, '') AS gene_symbol,
    NULLIF(b.biomarker_description, '') AS biomarker_description
  FROM biomarker b
  WHERE b.id IS NOT NULL
    AND b.id <> ''
),
disease_by_name AS (
  SELECT
    d.id AS disease_id,
    d.name AS disease_name
  FROM disease d
  WHERE d.name = 'breast cancer'
),
disease_mutation_with_annotations AS (
  SELECT
    dm.id,
    dm.chromosome_id,
    dm.chromosome_pos,
    dm.ref_nt,
    dm.alt_nt,
    dm.ensembl_transcript_id,
    dm.cds_pos,
    dm.peptide_pos,
    dm.aa_pos_uniprotkb,
    dm.ref_aa,
    dm.alt_aa,
    dm.mutation_freq,
    dm.data_source,
    dm.doid,
    dma.pmid,
    dmip.site_prediction,
    dmip.probability,
    dmip.tool,
    dmsa.description AS site_description,
    dmsa.feature_key,
    dmt.uberon_anatomical_id
  FROM disease_mutation dm
  LEFT JOIN disease_mutation_article dma
    ON dma.disease_mutation_id = dm.id
  LEFT JOIN disease_mutation_impact_prediction dmip
    ON dmip.disease_mutation_id = dm.id
  LEFT JOIN disease_mutation_site_annotation dmsa
    ON dmsa.disease_mutation_id = dm.id
  LEFT JOIN disease_mutation_tissue dmt
    ON dmt.disease_mutation_id = dm.id
),
differential_expression_by_gene_disease AS (
  SELECT
    gene_symbol,
    doid,
    log2fc,
    pvalue,
    adjpvalue,
    statistical_significance,
    expression_change_direction,
    subjects_up,
    subjects_down,
    subjects_nochange,
    subjects_nocoverage,
    subjects_total
  FROM differential_expression
),
biomarker_evidence_by_doid AS (
  SELECT
    source_row.evidence_source,
    source_row.source_table_id,
    source_row.linked_biomarker_id,
    source_row.linked_gene_symbol,
    source_row.doid
  FROM (
    SELECT
      'biomarker_fda_test'::text AS evidence_source,
      bt.test_submission::text AS source_table_id,
      bt.id::text AS linked_biomarker_id,
      NULL::character varying AS linked_gene_symbol,
      bt.doid::bigint AS doid
    FROM biomarker_fda_tests_w_drugs_ncit bt
    WHERE bt.test_submission IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
      'differential_expression'::text AS evidence_source,
      de.gene_symbol || '|' || de.doid::text AS source_table_id,
      de.gene_symbol::text AS linked_biomarker_id,
      de.gene_symbol::character varying AS linked_gene_symbol,
      de.doid::bigint AS doid
    FROM differential_expression_by_gene_disease de

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
      'disease_mutation'::text AS evidence_source,
      dm.id::text AS source_table_id,
      COALESCE(gm.gene_symbol, dm.ensembl_transcript_id::text, dm.id::text) AS linked_biomarker_id,
      gm.gene_symbol::character varying AS linked_gene_symbol,
      dm.doid::bigint AS doid
    FROM disease_mutation_with_annotations dm
    LEFT JOIN gene_ensembl_to_uniprot_map gm
      ON gm.ensembl_gene_id = dm.ensembl_transcript_id

  ) AS source_row
)
SELECT DISTINCT b.gene_symbol,
       b.biomarker_description
FROM disease_by_name d
JOIN biomarker_evidence_by_doid e
  ON d.disease_id = e.doid
JOIN biomarker_core_88 b
  ON (b.biomarker_id = e.linked_biomarker_id OR b.gene_symbol = e.linked_gene_symbol)
WHERE b.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL
  AND b.biomarker_description IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY b.gene_symbol
